tools.name: ip_lookup_lite
tools.description: Look up an IP address: country, continent, ASN and network operator. Served from our local dataset, sub-5ms. Needs a free key. Example: ip="8.8.8.8" returns US, AS15169.

tools.name: ip_lookup_max
tools.description: Full IP intelligence: precise geolocation, network and ASN data, VPN / proxy / Tor / hosting detection and threat data. Needs a free key. Example: ip="1.1.1.1" returns Brisbane, AU plus the privacy and hosting flags.

tools.name: ip_lookup_batch
tools.description: Look up 1-100 IP addresses in one call. kind "lite" = country/ASN from our local dataset; kind "max" = full intelligence. Needs a free key. Example: ips=["8.8.8.8","1.1.1.1"], kind="lite".

tools.name: asn_lookup
tools.description: Look up an autonomous system by number: name, domain, country, and prefixCount — a sampled IPv4 /24 size proxy, NOT a count of announced routes. No key needed. Example: asn="AS15169" returns Google LLC, google.com, US.

tools.name: asn_search
tools.description: Search the ASN directory for a network operator. No key needed. Example: q="cloudflare", country="US" returns Cloudflare, Inc. as AS13335.
